# Nick Goergen's portfolio: videos, apps and automations

> Nick makes short product ads, launch videos and music films using code, 3D animation and AI. He also builds web apps, scrapers and automations, and fixes AI-built apps that break once they go live.

- [Portfolio](https://port.nickdidit.net/): Selected work and the video viewer.
- [Code and systems](https://port.nickdidit.net/#code): A members' practice app, request routing for small teams, a scraper with a ranked review board, and app rescue for AI-built apps.
- [Upwork profile](https://www.upwork.com/freelancers/~016a59fef2b0e52da1): Freelance video, app and automation services and project inquiries.
- [Hi I'm Nick on YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/@soulandthescale): Nick's music films and Shorts.
- [About Nick](https://nickdidit.net/about/): Nick's music and practice work.
